newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates fluctuate to end unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates fluctuate to end unchanged.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates seesawed on Monday, but bounced back towards the close on tight liquidity and are likely to stay high on Tuesday, dealers said.

"Borrowers started the day by picking overnight funds at 19.90 percent. Later the rates slipped to 14 percent on excess funds," a dealer said. "Towards the close, the rates jumped back to 20 percent on tight liquidity."
Dealers said one-month repos remained mismatched with bids and offers at 15.85 percent and 16.40 percent respectively.
